newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil slips with futures, some prems stronge.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil slips with futures, some prems stronge.

text.p: NWE physical gas oil fell on Friday, reflectng heavy losses on IPE futures. But some premiums rose, limiting the downward pull on outright prices.
March IPE gas oil closed down $3 a tonne at $170.50 confirming a shift into contango on the back of mild weather both sides of the Atlantic.
Barge premiums hovered around March IPE +$1, with talk of a deal at that level into Antwerp. Sellers looked for March +$2.
FOD cargo premiums pushed up to March IPE +$4-$6 cif NWE for second half February from $2-$4.
That was on the back of some interest from refiners looking to meet regulatory stock levels by the end of the month. Early March premiums weakened to March IPE +$3.50 or so.
DIN material was pegged around March IPE +$5 for Feb product, reflecting a cargo done yeserday at March +$5 cif Bremen or March +$4.50 cif Hamburg on Feb 24-28 dates.
A February GOM cargo was understood sold at March IPE +$15.50 cif NWE, which some dealers saw a touch under the market. EN590 premiums were holding up around March IPE +$19 cif NWE.
